policy: All indexes are views over shared canonical entities; no index replaces the historical archive.

indexes.name: Master Entity Index
indexes.scope: All entities; source IDs and canonical IDs remain distinct.

indexes.name: System Index
indexes.scope: Projects, systems, subsystems, and boundaries.

indexes.name: Architecture Index
indexes.scope: Layers, architecture variants, spines, and compositions.

indexes.name: Mechanism Index
indexes.scope: Mechanisms, algorithms, state transitions, and operational behavior.

indexes.name: Language Index
indexes.scope: Languages and DSLs; distinct from AST, IR, compiler, binder, kernel, runtime.

indexes.name: Representation Index
indexes.scope: AST, IR, V-IR, manifests, and structural representations.

indexes.name: Execution Index
indexes.scope: VX, kernel, runtime, bindings, workers, jobs, contracts.

indexes.name: Intelligence Index
indexes.scope: XV, minds, routing, composition, arbitration, intelligence allocation.

indexes.name: Knowledge Index
indexes.scope: LNS, memory, patterns, entities, causal and temporal knowledge.

indexes.name: Governance Index
indexes.scope: Constitution, policy, authority, capability controls, admission.

indexes.name: Verification Index
indexes.scope: VV, conformance, replay checks, and verifier outcomes.

indexes.name: Proof Index
indexes.scope: Evidence, proof obligations, proof results, and attestations.

indexes.name: Generation Index
indexes.scope: ASGF, generators, Forge, synthesis, candidate generation.

indexes.name: Genome Index
indexes.scope: System Genome, Architecture Genome, Capability Genome.

indexes.name: Simulation Index
indexes.scope: Digital Twin, counterfactuals, simulation and experiment evidence.

indexes.name: Evolution Index
indexes.scope: AEF, SER Ω, GROT, mutation, selection and promotion.

indexes.name: Operational Index
indexes.scope: OIF, health, readiness, recovery, observability, operations.

indexes.name: Project Index
indexes.scope: Project identity and owners.

indexes.name: Repository Index
indexes.scope: Repositories distinct from projects, systems, and components.

indexes.name: File Index
indexes.scope: Source files, content digests, generated artifacts.

indexes.name: Visual Index
indexes.scope: Diagrams and visual representations.

indexes.name: Lineage Index
indexes.scope: Origin, derivation, revision, and supersession.

indexes.name: Idea Registry
indexes.scope: Ideas stay distinct from innovations and implementations.

indexes.name: Innovation Registry
indexes.scope: Claims/candidates, origins, prior art, dependencies, evidence and lifecycle.

indexes.name: Subsystem Registry
indexes.scope: Subsystem identity and parent-child relations.

indexes.name: Language Registry
indexes.scope: Language definitions and versions.

indexes.name: Model Registry
indexes.scope: AI/solver models, capabilities, contracts and limits.

indexes.name: Protocol Registry
indexes.scope: Protocols, interfaces and compatibility.

indexes.name: Algorithm Registry
indexes.scope: Algorithm specifications and implementations.

indexes.name: Engine Registry
indexes.scope: Engines and offered capabilities.

indexes.name: Mind Registry
indexes.scope: Research, reasoning, planning, verification and specialist minds.

indexes.name: Intelligence Registry
indexes.scope: Intelligence capabilities, routes and composition policies.

indexes.name: Agent Registry
indexes.scope: Identity, owner, capabilities, tools, policies, memory and audit boundaries.

indexes.name: Artifact Registry
indexes.scope: Specs, builds, packages, reports, diagrams and generated outputs.

indexes.name: Evidence Registry
indexes.scope: Source-backed evidence with provenance and validation.

indexes.name: Capability Registry
indexes.scope: Preconditions, I/O, authority, limits, dependencies and proof obligations.

indexes.name: Authority Registry
indexes.scope: Permission, approval and delegation ownership.

indexes.name: Pattern Registry
indexes.scope: Recovered and derived reusable patterns.

indexes.name: Version Registry
indexes.scope: Revisions, compatibility and supersession history.

indexes.name: Project Registry
indexes.scope: Project entities and lineage.

indexes.name: System Registry
indexes.scope: Canonical systems and execution surfaces.

indexes.name: Model Registry
indexes.scope: Model identities and external-provider bindings.
